aiSummary: Faculty Atlas is currently tracking 25,035 open faculty positions — +638 compared to last week. Among listings matched to institution type, 70.9% are at public institutions and 29.1% are at private nonprofit institutions. Professor roles represent the largest category with 9,655 listings. Among positions with a known appointment track, 25.1% are tenure-track and 74.9% are non-tenure-track. 1,186 listings (4.7%) explicitly reference artificial intelligence or a core AI method. 109 listings (0.4%) address responsible technology, such as AI ethics, algorithmic fairness, or technology policy. Nursing is the most in-demand discipline among classified listings this week, with 868 open positions.
